description:
Create a checkout session.

A cart of 1–20 prices in one currency. Send the buyer to `url`, or open it in an overlay with pay.js (`data-session="cs_…"`). The buyer comes back to `return_url` after paying, `cancel_url` if they leave. Live mode: a new session is refused with 403 `bill_overdue` while a Perly Pay bill is unpaid past its 14 days.

Test keys only: refused with a live key.

custom_amount.description: Pay-what-you-want: the amount per unit in minor units (cents), an integer.

metadata.description: Your own key–value pairs (≤ 50 keys, values ≤ 500 characters). On an update they are merged in; an empty value removes its key.
